title: Projects
text:
Solar Heliostat Control and Instrumentation



Doctoral research at IER-UNAM since 2026, focused on closed-loop heliostat control through sensor-based feedback. The work places primary emphasis on computer vision while considering complementary sensing methods for positioning. The experimental research encompasses the heliostat, solar furnace, instrumentation and control system.


Doctoral Research Control Instrumentation






Interactive Solar Furnace Simulator


An educational and experimental simulator in development for exploring a solar furnace with a heliostat and faceted concentrator. It integrates solar tracking, reflection geometry, 3D visualization and reproducible experiments with orientation errors and correction strategies. It includes a web version that runs Python directly in the browser and a desktop version written in Python.


Python Shinylive Pyodide Codex 3D Visualization In Development

Data Science and Methodology for Climate Analysis


A 2026 academic workshop with reproducible materials for climate data analysis using automatic weather stations (EMA), EPW files and Jupyter notebooks. It integrates pandas, Plotly, Weather Data, Climate Consultant and EnerHabitat.


Jupyter pandas Plotly Climate



Site Repository






Hermes Multi-Agent AI Ecosystem


A multi-agent ecosystem with specialized roles for automating technical, academic, documentary and organizational workflows. Its agents run mainly on self-managed Raspberry Pi infrastructure and are accessed through Telegram chatbots, where users send instructions, ask questions and receive responses.


Python LLM Multi-Agent Systems Quarto Raspberry Pi Telegram Bots Automation Git



Sauron


The technical authority that administers the Raspberry Pi and the Hermes ecosystem: services, processes, logs, profiles, permissions, backups, gateways, automations and agent isolation. It diagnoses failures, prepares safe changes and coordinates the infrastructure.


Roger


The professional profile agent. It maintains Julio’s website, CV, portfolio, publications, Quarto, GitHub Pages and academic and professional narrative.


C-3PO


An organizational coordination agent, especially for CNEER. It turns conversations, pending tasks and agreements into minutes, follow-up, logistics, contacts, team coordination and operational documentation in Notion.


R2-D2


A documentary agent that transforms voice notes, spoken ideas, classes, meetings and logs into clear, structured Markdown for notes, minutes, working documents and reusable materials.


Tlamatini In Development


A CNEER conversational assistant under development to centralize information and guide attendees and participants through Telegram. The repository documents a Python implementation built on a Hermes profile, with a Telegram gateway, systemd services, Linux isolation and a Markdown knowledge base. It is presented as an active project for future editions rather than an already deployed public service.

title: About
text:
I have been a PhD student in Renewable Energy at IER-UNAM since 2026 and am a mechatronics engineer. Under the supervision of Dr. Camilo Arancibia, I research closed-loop control of solar heliostats using computer vision and complementary sensing methods.
I develop sensor-based feedback methods for heliostat positioning, with primary emphasis on computer vision. I carry out experimental work with the heliostat, solar furnace and control system at IER-UNAM. I also serve as a teaching assistant for the Solar Thermal Energy course, particularly solar geometry.
I consider myself a dedicated, versatile, meticulous, and creative person. I enjoy working in a team and learning from other perspectives, although I also greatly value working on my own, focused and in silence. This combination has accompanied me in different projects and experiences, and has given me a balance between the collective and the personal.
Sports play an important role in my life: I play soccer and athletics, which have taught me discipline, perseverance, and the satisfaction of gradually improving myself. Drawing and photography are hobbies that allow me to relax and keep my creative side alive, with no other goal than to enjoy the process.
Traveling and learning about other cultures is another important part of my life. It helps me broaden my vision and adapt easily to different contexts, something that I also transfer to my personal and academic projects.
Right now, I am motivated to continue growing in research and science, with a special interest in solar thermal energy, automation, bioclimatic design, and data analysis. I seek to find a balance between the technical and the human: to create solutions that are born out of curiosity and rigor, but that bring practical value to everyday life.

title: Acerca de mí
text:
Soy estudiante de Doctorado en Energías Renovables en el IER-UNAM desde 2026 e ingeniero en Mecatrónica. Bajo la supervisión del Dr. Camilo Arancibia, investigo el control en lazo cerrado de heliostatos solares mediante visión por computadora y métodos de sensado complementarios.
Desarrollo métodos de retroalimentación sensorial para el posicionamiento de heliostatos, con énfasis principal en visión por computadora. Realizo trabajo experimental con el heliostato, el horno solar y el sistema de control del IER-UNAM. También participo como ayudante en la asignatura de Energía Solar Térmica, particularmente en geometría solar.
Me considero una persona dedicada, versátil, meticulosa y creativa. Disfruto trabajar en equipo y aprender de otras miradas, aunque también valoro mucho avanzar por mi cuenta, concentrado y en silencio. Esa combinación me ha acompañado en distintos proyectos y experiencias, y me ha dado un equilibrio entre lo colectivo y lo personal.
El deporte ocupa un lugar importante en mi vida: practico fútbol y atletismo, y de ahí he aprendido disciplina, constancia y también la satisfacción de superarme poco a poco. El dibujo y la fotografía son para mí pasatiempos que me permiten relajarme y mantener vivo mi lado creativo, sin más objetivo que disfrutar del proceso.
Viajar y conocer otras culturas es otra parte importante de mi vida. Me ayuda a ampliar mi visión y a adaptarme con facilidad a distintos contextos, algo que también traslado a mis proyectos personales y académicos.
En este momento, me motiva seguir creciendo en la investigación y la ciencia, con especial interés en la energía solar térmica, la automatización, el diseño bioclimático y el análisis de datos. Busco encontrar un equilibrio entre lo técnico y lo humano: crear soluciones que nacen de la curiosidad y el rigor, pero que aporten valor práctico a la vida cotidiana.
